map.输入回波强度、回波顶高、回波面积，综合评估对流强度等级、冰雹概率与降水贡献。: Enter echo strength, echo top height, and echo area to assess convective intensity, hail probability, and precipitation contribution.
map.由风速与风压估结构受力。: Estimate structural loads from wind speed and wind pressure.
map.：风速 20 m/s、空气密度 1.225 → 动压=0.5×1.225×20²: : at 20 m/s with an air density of 1.225, the dynamic pressure is 0.5×1.225×20² ≈ 245 Pa; a 10 m² windward face takes about 2450 N, roughly 250 kgf, of force.
map.：设计抗风 0.5 kPa，实际 0.245 kPa 余量足；阵风 30 m/s: : designed for 0.5 kPa wind, the actual 0.245 kPa leaves comfortable margin; a 30 m/s gust gives 0.55 kPa, above the design value, so reinforcement is needed.
map.风压和风速平方关系？: How Does Wind Pressure Relate to the Square of Wind Speed?
map.动压∝风速平方，风速翻倍推力变 4 倍，所以大风破坏骤增。: Dynamic pressure ∝ the square of wind speed, so doubling the wind speed quadruples the force — which is why storm damage jumps so sharply.
map.风压单位 Pa 多大？: How Big Is a Wind Pressure in Pa?
map.1 Pa=1 N/m²，250 Pa 看似小但对大面积广告牌乘面积后总力很大。: 1 Pa = 1 N/m². A pressure of 250 Pa looks small, but multiplied by the area of a large billboard the total force is substantial.
